activation: Explicit newly captured preservation.project_evidence_externalization=1. Defaults remain 0 for historical captures.
design: Exact original baseline remains a native dependency. Metadata excludes capsule-referenced evidence even if present in that baseline. Metadata and evidence bounds and complete reconstructed project hash are enforced.
stopping_rule: Official saved-failure probe stops at first mismatch and preserves result. Unit tests may iterate on implementation.
acceptance: Exact full project hash after external evidence hydration
All external bytes assigned native save role
Missing or forged evidence rejected before restore publication
Metadata and evidence raw bounds enforced separately; aggregate commit bound includes evidence
New native capture export/cold restore preserves full project and source identity
official_probe: Exact saved failure plus newly captured native V2 checkpoint whose baseline already contains actual historical completion evidence; provider ID interruption, native ACK receipt interruption, exact export and cold closure.
revision_reason: Cover capsules already present in the captured baseline. V2 externalizes only capsule-referenced objects, including baseline objects; the native baseline role retains the exact complete original ZIP. Delta uses an exactly projected baseline; cold restore retains all original files.
